android.desc:
ENA Game Studio proudly presented "Christmas game- The Lost Santa" a fun-filled Christmas-themed escape game. A fantastic point-and-click game for all escape game lovers. With our newly launched game, We wish you Merry Christmas and New Year!

Welcome to the most challenging escape room game that lets you witness the thrilling adventure game that brings you all of the addictive gameplay.

Get ready for this winter season with 25 exciting levels where you can take on a variety of roles to get back lost Santa and enjoy Christmas Eve with your family.

Train your brain with this Christmas puzzle game!

Find the hidden objects! Meet your favorite Christmas characters Elf, Snowman, Christmas fairies, deer, and Santa Claus! If you enjoy playing hidden object games and puzzles, you'll enjoy our Christmas festival games! So get your version of Secret Objects & Santa Christmas room Mystery right away!

Our games will put your concentration and cognitive abilities to the test! Investigate the mystery room in this Puzzle-Adventure game. 

Can you find the missing Santa? Grab the items and use them from your inventory to solve the riddles and get back the cursed life.

Are you ready to escape the Christmas room, complete the snow levels, and triumph in this incredible stunning adventure? The variety of new levels, where interesting brainstorming puzzles mix with classic door games, will delight you during the winter season.

Features:
*25 Challenging levels.
*More than 50+ unique puzzles
*The game Localized in 25 major languages
*Family  Entertained suitable for all ages.
*Amazing Christmas theme gameplay.
*Humane advanced hints for perfect assistance.
*Earn candy through  level end rewards.
